title: Multimodal investigation of dacomitinib–calf thymus DNA binding interaction: insights from spectroscopy, thermodynamics, and in-silico studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5437-5454
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09242F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manal A. Alossaimi, Taibah Aldakhil, Heba Elmansi, Fathalla Belal, Galal Magdy
An integrated experimental and computational study reveals that dacomitinib preferentially binds calf thymus DNA via minor groove interactions, providing new insight into non-covalent DNA engagement by kinase inhibitors.
